about: Q8: shown under 'How to use it' when the source site has no text for a variant (or the cheap summary has not been written yet). One fixed note per build type. No model writes these.

types.Close Range: Built for short, fast fights. Move, flank and take corners; fire as soon as you come out of a sprint or a slide. Avoid long open lanes with this one.
types.Long Range: Built to win the first shot from far away. Hold a lane or an angle, stay off the radar, control the recoil and move after every kill.
types.Sniper: Built to win the first shot from far away. Hold a lane or an angle, stay off the radar, control the recoil and move after every kill.
types.Versatile: A balanced build for most maps: good at middle range with manageable recoil. Use it when you do not know where the fights will be.
types.Apex Attachment: Needs the gun at its max level for the Apex attachment, which changes how the gun handles. Practise it in a casual mode before you take it into S&D or ranked play.
types.Pro (Ranked): A build pro players run in tournaments, tuned for ranked play. It asks for good aim and rewards control more than comfort.

fallback: A published meta build. Try it in a few matches of the modes listed above and keep it if your kill pace improves.
